summary: Empirically proven: PosCounterCollectModal encaissement of a kiosk-cash order in PREPARING preserves KDS state (status unchanged), composition_snapshot bit-identical (NF525 §8 frozen), allergens_snapshot bit-identical, audit_logs append-only with valid HMAC chain (verifyChain=null), fiscal_sequence_no preserved (no re-allocation, no gap), and is idempotent on replay (both middleware-level AND service-level short-circuit at PaymentService.php:227-230).

scope.frozen_zones_touched: 0 (new test file only, no implementation change)

V5.1_kds_state_preserved.evidence: status=7 (PREPARING) pre AND post; payment_status flipped PENDING_COUNTER→PAID; pos_payment_method set to CASH (=1); pos_received_amount=20.00. Only payment-related fields mutate.
V5.1_kds_state_preserved.static_analysis_note: Wave S-1 auto-prepare (PaymentService.php:271-294) only fires when prePaidStatus===ACCEPT; orders already in PREPARING bypass that branch entirely. Verified by seeding directly in PREPARING.
V5.1_kds_state_preserved.carve_out_note: When the order is in ACCEPT and mode is non-CASH, Wave S-1 auto-prepare DOES promote ACCEPT→PREPARING. This is by-design behavior (kitchen-release on paid). Verified by reading PaymentService.php:271-294 and AutoPrepareOnPaidPolicy::shouldPromote logic.

V5.2_composition_snapshot_frozen.evidence: composition_snapshot bytes bit-identical pre/post (DB.table('order_items')->value()); SHA-256 also bit-identical. allergens_snapshot also bit-identical (same DB row never written to by PaymentService).
V5.2_composition_snapshot_frozen.static_analysis_note: grep -n 'composition_snapshot' app/Services/PaymentService.php → ZERO mutations. PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment touches Order (lines 245-282), Transaction (lines 296-307), AuditLog (lines 309-321), CashMovement (line 362-364, via recordCashOrderMovement). order_items.composition_snapshot is NEVER written to by this code path. NF525 §8 invariant honored.

V5.3_audit_logs_append_only.evidence: audit_logs count advanced by exactly +1 (one 'order.counter_payment_confirmed' row appended). HMAC chain verified via AuditLogService::verifyChain($branchId) → null (CHAIN OK).
V5.3_audit_logs_append_only.chain_verify_result: OK (verifyChain returned null — no broken row)
V5.3_audit_logs_append_only.static_analysis_note: PaymentService.php:309-321 calls AuditLogService::write() with append-only semantics. No DELETE; UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) prevents fork; BEFORE DELETE trigger SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' (MySQL prod only) prevents tampering.

V5.4_fiscal_sequence_preserved.evidence: fiscal_sequence_no=42 pre AND post (seeded with non-null value to exercise the guard at PaymentService.php:241-243). No re-allocation. No gap.
V5.4_fiscal_sequence_preserved.static_analysis_note: PaymentService.php:241-243 `if ($locked->fiscal_sequence_no === null) { $locked->fiscal_sequence_no = app(FiscalSequenceService::class)->next(...); }`. Allocation ONLY when null. Kiosk-paid orders that already burned a sequence at creation keep their number; the encaissement is a payment confirmation, NOT a fiscal mutation.

V5.5_idempotency_replay_safety.evidence_layer_1_middleware: Second POST with same X-Idempotency-Key returns 200 with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` header; audit_logs count does NOT advance (no double-collect).
V5.5_idempotency_replay_safety.evidence_layer_2_service: Second POST with DIFFERENT idempotency key (middleware cache miss) still no-ops: PaymentService.php:227-230 detects payment_status===PAID and returns the locked row without mutating. fiscal_sequence_no still 99, audit_logs count for the order still 1.

domain_events_dispatched: OrderStatusChanged (ONLY when ACCEPT→PREPARING auto-prepare fires; suppressed when seeded directly in PREPARING)
side_effects_audit.cash_movement_recorded: PaymentService::recordCashOrderMovement (best-effort, only if mode=CASH and an open CashDrawerSession exists)

evidence_chain: Static analysis: grep -n 'composition_snapshot' app/Services/PaymentService.php → 0 hits. Read PaymentService.php:193-368 confirms no order_items writes inside confirmCounterPayment.
Regression: tests/Feature/Payment/CounterDeferredPaymentLifecycleTest.php + tests/Feature/Idempotency/CounterCollectAndPrintIdempotencyTest.php still GREEN (9 tests across both, 27+ assertions)
Empirical snapshot of pre/post DB state preserved at storage/app/c5-encaisser-kds-preserve.report.json
next_actions_recommended: No-op for V1 GREEN — invariants hold. Continue Phase B.2 with remaining SYNC CHAIN AGENT missions (C1, C2, C3, C4, C6+).
Consider promoting C5 test to a sentinel by adding it to a tagged suite (e.g. @group nf525-invariants) if not already in the default CI run.
caveats_and_gaps: V5.5 layer 1 (middleware replay) test asserts the Idempotency-Replayed header. The cache lookup uses minute-bucketed keys per IdempotencyKeyMiddleware design — in a flaky CI clock crossing a minute boundary, an extremely rare false-positive double-execute could slip past layer 1. Layer 2 (service-level short-circuit on payment_status===PAID) catches that residual case.

Test seeds run under SQLite RefreshDatabase. MySQL prod has additional BEFORE DELETE SIGNAL trigger on audit_logs + z_reports that this SQLite suite does NOT exercise (driver-gated DDL in the migration). Production tampering protection is verified separately by the production migration trigger tests.
